summary: CASSANALYTICS-124 fixes BufferingCommitLogReader.position so CommitLogReader.Result.isFullyRead() can become true: it sets position to startMarker.position() on seek, to log.maxOffset() on the end-of-segment marker and after the section loop finishes naturally, and only advances position per section when statusTracker.shouldContinue(). The test change makes the first log 'completed' and asserts position == maxOffset and isFullyRead(). Applied bundle checklists: refdir .../shallow-review/references/general/specialists/absence.md and completeness.md, and analytics/DEV-README.md, plus the cass-completeness-symmetry notes in analytics-standards.md. BufferingCommitLogReader exists only in cassandra-four-zero-bridge, so there are no other bridge copies to keep in sync. The only isFullyRead() consumer is CdcScannerBuilder, which the fix serves. Not reviewed: nothing. One low-confidence regression concern in the refactor aftermath of the position-update guard.

findings.title: Advance position when a section ends via the <4 bytes left termination
findings.rule: refactor aftermath: all termination paths of readSection must leave position correct
findings.problem: The new guard 'if (statusTracker.shouldContinue()) position = reader.getFilePointer()' skips the update for every requestTermination() path, not just the end-of-segment marker. The 'end - reader.getFilePointer() < 4' branch (around line 436) calls requestTermination() after the section's mutations were fully read, and the patch adds no position update there. Trigger: a legacy section whose last mutation ends fewer than 4 bytes before the section end. Mutations in that section are handed to the caller, but position (and the listener marker and Result marker) stays at the previous section's end. The next read then re-emits those mutations, and isFullyRead() stays false for a completed log. Before the patch, position was advanced after readSection on this path. Only the end-of-segment branch was patched.
findings.fix: Set this.position = (int) reader.getFilePointer() (or log.maxOffset() when end of the segment is reached) in the 'not enough bytes left' branch before requestTermination(). Alternatively, advance position after readSection unless an error was actually raised, rather than keying on shouldContinue().
